title: Volume and surface area of composite solids
summary: Combine component measures and remove overlaps, holes or hidden faces.
objectives: Add or subtract component volumes without double-counting.
Remove two copies of each hidden contact face from surface area.
Solve multi-step capacity and material problems involving composite solids.

blocks.text: Combine component measures and remove overlaps, holes or hidden faces. Keep every measurement in compatible units before substituting.

sections.title: Worked example

prompt.text: Two cuboids of volumes 180 cm³ and 75 cm³ are joined without overlap. Find the total volume.

sections.verification_note: The result uses compatible units and agrees with the dimensions and component structure.

prompt.text: A 6 cm by 5 cm by 4 cm cuboid has a 2 cm cube removed. Find the remaining volume in cm³.

blocks.text: Sketch or decompose the figure, label compatible units, select the correct area or volume relationship, calculate in clear stages, and check that the final unit is squared or cubed as required.
